sources.title: Gemini CLI README
sources.locator: Status banner; Installation; Authentication Options; Key Features
sources.finding: Open-source terminal agent now maintained for enterprise Gemini Code Assist workflows; free individual access and Google AI Pro/Ultra moved to Antigravity CLI on 2026-06-18; npm, npx, Homebrew, MacPorts and conda install; Google login, Gemini API key and Vertex AI auth; headless -p mode.

sources.title: Installation and system specifications
sources.finding: Recommended OS: macOS 15+, Windows 11 24H2+, Ubuntu 20.04+; Node.js 20+; Bash, Zsh or PowerShell; preview weekly, stable weekly, nightly daily channels.

sources.title: Authentication
sources.locator: Choose your authentication method; Sign in with Google; Gemini API key; Vertex AI; headless
sources.finding: Google account login (individual and organization), Gemini API key and Vertex AI authentication; Cloud project required for organization accounts.

sources.title: Quotas and pricing
sources.finding: Pinned docs still describe free-tier request quotas (1,000/day Code Assist individuals, 250/day unpaid API key), paid tiers and pay-as-you-go; this conflicts with the README banner that moved free access to Antigravity CLI.

sources.title: Git worktrees (experimental)
sources.locator: How to enable Git worktrees; gemini --worktree
sources.finding: Experimental setting enables gemini --worktree to give each session its own worktree under .gemini/worktrees; worktrees are left intact on exit and cleanup is manual.

sources.title: Tracker tools
sources.finding: Experimental tracker_* tools let the agent keep a persistent per-session graph of tasks (epic, task, bug) with status, dependencies and parent IDs stored under .gemini/tmp/tracker/<session-id>.

sources.title: Subagents
sources.locator: What are subagents; How to use subagents
sources.finding: Specialist subagents with own prompt, tools and context window exposed as tools; automatic delegation or explicit invocation; results reported back to the main agent.

sources.title: Remote subagents
sources.finding: Connects to remote subagents over the Agent-to-Agent (A2A) protocol.

sources.title: Session management
sources.finding: Sessions saved automatically under ~/.gemini/tmp/<project_hash>/chats with prompts, tool executions, token stats; resumable and project-scoped; retention configurable.

sources.title: Sandboxing
sources.finding: Sandboxing via macOS Seatbelt (sandbox-exec), Docker, Podman, runsc or LXC, enabled by flag, env or settings.

sources.title: Observability with OpenTelemetry
sources.finding: Built-in OpenTelemetry logs, metrics and traces exportable to local files or cloud backends.

sources.title: Configuration reference
sources.finding: privacy.usageStatisticsEnabled controls usage statistics; approval modes default, auto_edit, plan and yolo (CLI flag only); telemetry.enabled and target settings.

sources.title: Plan Mode
sources.finding: Read-only plan mode enabled by default; plans written before implementation.

sources.title: Checkpointing
sources.finding: Automatic snapshot of project state before approved file-modifying tools, restorable with /restore.

sources.title: ACP mode
sources.finding: Agent Client Protocol over stdio for IDE and developer-tool integration.

sources.title: Headless mode
sources.finding: Non-interactive mode with -p/--prompt or non-TTY returns text or JSON output including usage statistics.

sources.title: IDE integration
sources.finding: Gemini CLI Companion VS Code extension (also on Antigravity) and ACP integrations for JetBrains and Zed enable native in-editor diffing.

sources.title: Enterprise admin controls
sources.finding: Admin controls from the Management Console enforce policies that users cannot override locally.

sources.title: Notifications (experimental)
sources.finding: Experimental system notifications when a session completes or needs attention.

sources.title: Hooks
sources.finding: Scripts executed at defined lifecycle points of the agent loop.

sources.title: Policy engine
sources.finding: Policy engine governs tool approval decisions via rule files.

sources.title: Agent skills
sources.finding: Agent skills discovered from user and workspace locations and activated by the model.

sources.title: GEMINI.md context files
sources.finding: Hierarchical GEMINI.md instruction files plus memory tool and experimental auto memory.

sources.title: Auto Memory
sources.finding: Experimental background mining of past sessions that proposes durable memory updates and reusable skills.

sources.title: MCP servers
sources.finding: MCP client with stdio, SSE and HTTP transports, OAuth discovery and trust settings.

sources.title: Terms of service and privacy
sources.finding: Privacy and data handling depend on authentication type and subscription; points to Google privacy notices.

sources.title: A2A server README
sources.finding: All code in the a2a-server package is experimental and under active development.

sources.title: Gemini CLI SDK
sources.finding: @google/gemini-cli-sdk provides a programmatic interface to Gemini models and tools.

sources.title: run-gemini-cli README
sources.finding: Official GitHub Action invoking Gemini CLI for PR review, issue triage and @gemini-cli commands, triggered by events or schedules on GitHub runners; Apache-2.0, 2,129 stars.

sources.finding: Public repository with 108,868 stars on 2026-11-16, Apache-2.0 license.

sources.title: Tracker tools implementation
sources.finding: Implements tracker_create_task, update, get, list and add_dependency tools backing the experimental task graph.

sources.title: VS Code IDE companion package
sources.finding: Source of the Gemini CLI Companion extension that provides native diffing and workspace context to the CLI.

sources.title: Tracker service
sources.finding: Tracker tasks are stored as one JSON file per task ID; updateTask keeps the ID while allowing type, status and dependency changes, rejects missing parents and circular dependencies, and refuses to close a task until all its dependencies are closed; no code propagates state to parents or children.

sources.title: Settings schema
sources.locator: privacy.usageStatisticsEnabled (line 970, default true); model.maxSessionTurns; tools.shell.inactivityTimeout; billing.overageStrategy
sources.finding: Settings schema defaults: usage statistics enabled true, maxSessionTurns -1 (unlimited), shell inactivity timeout 300 seconds, AI-credit overage strategy ask.

sources.title: run-gemini-cli scheduled triage workflow
sources.finding: Example scheduled workflow sets a GitHub concurrency group with cancel-in-progress and a 7-minute job timeout; other examples use 30 minutes; no retry configuration appears in the example workflows.

sources.title: A2A client manager
sources.finding: Sends messages to a loaded remote A2A agent and streams responses; local subagents expose no follow-up API in packages/core/src/agents.

sources.title: Bounded source search of the pinned release
sources.locator: Paths packages/core/src, packages/cli/src, packages/a2a-server/src, docs; terms: multiplayer, co-prompt, collaborat, rbac, saml, organization role, cron, scheduler (matches are the tool-call scheduler), createPullRequest, pull request, kanban, issue tracker, backlog, webhook
sources.finding: No multi-user collaboration, role model, scheduled-task runner, pull request creation tool, issue board or webhook sender exists in the inspected paths; matches were prompt text, the internal tool-call scheduler and unrelated identifiers.

sources.title: run-gemini-cli issue fixer command prompt
sources.locator: Step 8 'Create Pull Request' (line 55-56); .github/workflows/gemini-issue-fixer.yml job create-pr with pull-requests: write and step 'Run Gemini PR Create'; examples/workflows/gemini-assistant/gemini-plan-execute.yml allows create_pull_request
sources.finding: The official GitHub Action repository includes issue-fixer and plan-execute workflows that run Gemini CLI on a GitHub runner with pull-requests: write and instruct it to open a pull request through the GitHub MCP create_pull_request tool; Gemini CLI itself has no pull request tool.
